mapper.select: SELECT room_idx AS roomIdx, admin_idx AS adminIdx, room_name AS roomName, room_level AS roomLevel, room_info AS roomInfo, room_price AS roomPrice, room_people AS roomPeople, room_image AS roomImage, room_memo AS roomMemo, room_sale_yn AS roomSaleYN FROM "ROOM" WHERE room_sale_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY room_idx

SELECT room_idx AS roomIdx, admin_idx AS adminIdx, room_name AS roomName, room_level AS roomLevel, room_info AS roomInfo, room_price AS roomPrice, room_people AS roomPeople, room_image AS roomImage, room_memo AS roomMemo, room_sale_yn AS roomSaleYN FROM "ROOM" WHERE room_idx = #{roomIdx}
SELECT MIN(room_price) FROM "ROOM" WHERE room_level = #{roomLevel} AND room_sale_yn = 'Y'
